title: Effect of different leaching agents on the recycling of valuable metals in spent molybdenum-based catalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8593-8600
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00053C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaoxue Sun, Deju Wang, Junlin Zheng, Renjie Li, Fenglei Xi
Conventional hydrometallurgical recycling of spent molybdenum-based catalysts is often constrained by a trade-off between selectivity and total metal recovery when using single-step alkaline or acidic leaching.
